method: Walked /photography/albums/Re7kho at 390 and 1280 pixels and /photography/share/<token> at 920 pixels against the local dev server after changing single-album photo order from upload_date+image_key to capture time (photo_date) then image_key. The grid now reads in shutter order (01..13 then 056..064 then 14.., matching EXIF DateTimeOriginal) instead of the text sort of exported filenames. Page 2 from /api/album-photos continues contiguously from page 1 (073 then 074) and the download manifest lists the same order. Document scrollWidth equals clientWidth at all three widths. Layout, Popular in this album strip, header and subnav are unchanged; only row order moved.
scope: album photo order by capture time
